title: Constitutional Graph Engineering — 7-Gap Taxonomy
summary: Graph engineering (node/edge/state/router/gate) covers mechanics but misses 7 institutional layers: (1) Gödel lock — no self-certification, independence measured not assumed; (2) Irreversibility gradient — not all edges equal, F1 AMANAH; (3) Sealed consequence — VAULT999 append-only hash chain; (4) Reality as final auditor — live probe, not assumption; (5) Model demotion trap — capability floor gate; (6) HITL taxonomy — authorization vs cognitive separation; (7) Fork governance — identity propagation on clone.

title: Benchmark Phrasing Fragility — BenchDrift (IBM, 2026-08-12)
summary: Benchmark scores depend on single phrasing of each problem. Rephrasing while holding meaning+answer fixed routinely flips correctness in both directions. Two critical findings: (1) Phrasing sensitivity changes sign with model strength — weak models gain from rephrasing, strong models LOSE. Top benchmark performers are the most phrasing-dependent. Ranking deltas at the top are noise. (2) Fragility belongs to the rephrasing, not the model — all models agree on which rephrasings break answers. Implication: benchmark-based model selection is unreliable at the top; live-probe and task-specific evaluation are required.
operational_impact: Validates arifOS's refusal to trust static benchmarks for model governance. FED routes by live latency+task fitness, not benchmark rank. Capability floor gate (clamp_model_autonomy) detects real demotion, not benchmark noise. Model picker must never use benchmark deltas as primary signal.

title: Human Meaning Membrane — Pragmatic Intent Decoding
summary: Human utterances are compressed multi-layer packets (register+intent+test+metaphor). Primary agent failures: LITERALIZATION (mangkuk ayun becomes a bowl), MORALIZATION (slang treated as pathology), MYTHOLOGIZATION (flattering theory amplification). Countermeasure: IntentStateEnvelope — raw span preserved, >=3 candidate interpretations, epistemic tags survive every hop, confidence capped, consent/action-authority fields. Hermes=encoder, agents prompt agents with clean envelopes.
operational_impact: All Hermes/OpenClaw inbound decoding; AAA transport validation; blocks semantic laundering across hops.

title: Paradox as Signal — Multi-Axis Human State + Rasa Epistemology
summary: Human contradiction is one of {measurement error, context change, ambiguity, deception, genuine multi-axis complexity} — test all five before resolving. Human state = independent axes (A,D,R,P,V,I,G,B,X,C,Q) scoreable high simultaneously; no label collapses the vector. Rasa (sensation+affect+intuition+embodied knowing+attunement) is first-class epistemic modality — REPORTED experience, never proof, never consent detector.
operational_impact: Person-modeling in agent memory: versioned contextual claims with expiry, never identity essences. RASA tag enters epistemic grammar.

title: Manipulation Capacity Formula + Output Contract Discipline
summary: Manipulative capacity = personal_data + accurate_inference + persistent_memory + optimization_for_undisclosed_outcome. Countermeasures: P-01..P-07 policy gates, 4-countermodel requirement, witness anti-dependency. SECOND failure mode discovered same night: OUTPUT_CONTRACT_FAILURE — agent dumps exceed budget, mix OBSERVED/INFERRED/ACTION, no sealed decision packet. Countermeasure: 7-section contract (STATUS/UNDERSTANDING/EVIDENCE/UNCERTAINTY/DECISION/NEXT_ACTION/HOLD) with word budgets 1200/500/300.
operational_impact: Response discipline across all warga agents; eval harness regression tests for literalization-resistance and epistemic-integrity.
